_comment: Train/eval split of the 25 official games for on-policy distillation.
Difficulty = mean score over 10 passes in runs/20260723_084737_asrun-kv-25games
(overall mean 1.73). Games are rank-ordered by that score and every 5th is
held out, starting at rank 2, so the eval set is a stratified miniature of the
full distribution instead of a difficulty-biased slice. Rank 1 (ft09, 11.49,
solved 6/10) stays in train on purpose: it is the highest-variance game and
Eval set spans two reliably-solved games (regression detection), one coin-flip
game, and two the base model has never solved (headroom).
